title: About
text:
I’m Will Snyder, a current senior at Western Washington University pursuing mechanistic interpretability research. I usually write up a lot in private including thoughts on failures/successes that I’ve had, methodology for self-learning, and more concrete stuff from stuff I’ve learned/done. I hope that making parts of my writing help those who are interested in discovering and going further in this niche as well.
I’m also a bit of a language nerd and am (somewhat) fluent in Japanese. Expect some content and easter eggs there as well.
